title: Modul POS - Discount & Promotion - Panduan Lengkap
description: Panduan lengkap menerapkan diskon dan promosi di POS mencakup tipe-tipe diskon, approval workflow, voucher, dan audit trail untuk compliance.
author: Tim GIMS

content.body: Discount & Promotion adalah fitur untuk memberikan potongan harga kepada customer dengan berbagai metode (percentage, fixed, voucher) dan approval workflow untuk control & compliance. Setiap diskon tercatat di audit trail untuk revenue tracking dan fraud prevention.

items.title: 1. Item-Level Discount (Diskon Per Item)
items.body:
Diskon ke individual item di keranjang.

**Use Cases:**
- Product promo: "Bakso diskon 20%"
- Loyalty reward: "Member dapat 10% off specific item"
- Bundle deal: "Beli 2 gratis 1" (item ketiga jadi free)

**Proses:**

1. Add item ke cart (contoh: Bakso @ Rp 25.000)
2. Click item di cart
3. Select 'Apply Discount'
4. Dialog muncul:
   - Discount type: Percentage atau Fixed Amount
   - Input value:
     * If %: Input 20 → Discount Rp 5.000
     * If Rp: Input 5000 → Discount Rp 5.000
   - Final price: Rp 20.000 (after discount)
5. Confirm
6. Item show:
   - Original: Rp 25.000 (strikethrough)
   - Discount: -Rp 5.000
   - Final: Rp 20.000

**Multiple Items:**
- Each item independent
- Different discount per item
- Example:
  * Bakso: Diskon 20%
  * Es Teh: No discount
  * Gorengan: Diskon Rp 2.000

**Validation:**
- Cannot discount > 99% (prevent free item)
- Cannot discount negative (error)
- Cannot discount item already discounted (re-apply override)

items.title: 2. Order-Level Discount (Diskon Keseluruhan)
items.body:
Diskon ke total order (setelah semua item dimasukkan).

**Use Cases:**
- "Beli Rp 100K+ dapat potongan Rp 10K"
- "Member loyalty: 5% off total"
- "Happy hour: All orders 15% off"
- "Promo flash sale: Extra 10K off"

**Proses:**

1. Add items ke cart
2. Cart total: Rp 70.000
3. Click 'Apply Order Discount' atau 'Discount' button
4. Dialog:
   - Discount type: % atau Rp
   - Input value:
     * If %: Input 10 → Discount Rp 7.000
     * If Rp: Input 15000 → Discount Rp 15.000 (if allowed)
5. Preview: "Total akan jadi Rp XX"
6. Confirm
7. Cart update:
   - Subtotal: Rp 70.000
   - Discount: -Rp 7.000
   - Total: Rp 63.000

**Validation:**
- Cannot exceed order total
- Cannot apply multiple order discounts (last one override)
- Discount + tax recalculation

items.title: 3. Voucher/Promo Code Discount
items.body:
Diskon dengan kode promo yang customer punya.

**Voucher Types:**
- Fixed discount: "BELI2GRATIS1" = Rp 50K off
- Percentage: "MEMBER10" = 10% off
- Buy X get Y: "BELI3DISKON" = Buy 3+ items get 20%
- Free item: "FREEMENU" = Free appetizer

**Proses:**

1. Customer punya voucher/promo code: "BELI2GRATIS1"
2. At checkout, click 'Voucher' atau 'Promo Code'
3. Input field appear
4. Enter code: "BELI2GRATIS1"
5. Click 'Verify' atau 'Apply'
6. System check:
   - Code exists?
   - Code active (not expired)?
   - Applicable untuk order ini? (min purchase, item filter, etc)
7. If valid: Discount applied automatically
   - Display: "Voucher BELI2GRATIS1 applied: Rp 50K off"
   - Total updated
8. If invalid: Error message
   - "Code not found" / "Code expired" / "Not applicable"

**Voucher Tracking:**
- Each voucher linked ke customer
- Usage limit: 1-time use or multiple
- Expiry date: Set by promo
- Record: When used, by whom, discount amount

**Example Vouchers:**
```
Code: BELI2GRATIS1
Type: Buy 2 Free 1
Discount: Rp 50.000 (on 3rd item)
Expiry: May 31, 2026
Usage: 1-time
Status: Active

Code: MEMBER10
Type: Percentage
Discount: 10% off
Min purchase: Rp 100.000
Expiry: Ongoing
Usage: Multiple
Status: Active
```

items.title: Approval Threshold
items.body:
**Threshold Rules:**

- Discount < Rp 50.000 (configurable):
  * Cashier can apply without approval
  * Direct execution
  * Auto-recorded

- Discount >= Rp 50.000:
  * Require manager approval
  * Cashier request → Manager review
  * Manager approve/reject
  * Approval recorded

**Why Threshold?**
- Control fraud (prevent cashier abuse)
- Revenue protection (track large discount)
- Audit compliance (manager accountability)
- Flexible (small discount quick, large discount controlled)

items.title: Approval Process
items.body:
**Scenario:** Cashier apply Rp 100.000 diskon (> threshold)

1. **Cashier Apply Discount:**
   - Input discount: Rp 100.000
   - System check: Amount > threshold?
   - Yes → Require approval
   - Dialog: "This discount requires manager approval"

2. **Manager Notification:**
   - Manager device/app get notification
   - Info: Operator name, outlet, amount, reason
   - Pending approval count badge (1)
   - List pending approvals di manager interface

3. **Manager Review:**
   - Manager open approval request
   - View: Cashier name, order detail, discount amount, reason
   - Option to:
     * APPROVE: Click 'Approve' + enter PIN
     * REJECT: Click 'Reject' + reason

4. **Manager Approve:**
   - Enter manager PIN/password (verification)
   - Or fingerprint (if supported)
   - Click 'Confirm Approve'
   - System:
     * Record approval: Timestamp, manager name
     * Apply discount to order
     * Update order total
     * Cashier see: "Discount approved"
     * Proceed with payment

5. **Manager Reject:**
   - Click 'Reject'
   - Input reason: "Discount policy violation", "Too high", etc
   - Click 'Confirm Reject'
   - System:
     * Notify cashier: "Discount rejected"
     * Discount not applied
     * Cashier options:
       - Try lower discount amount
       - Explain situation
       - Escalate to supervisor

6. **Timeout:**
   - Default: 5 min untuk manager respond
   - If timeout: Cashier can retry request
   - Or use alternative promotion
   - Escalate ke supervisor jika manager unavailable

items.title: Multi-Level Approval (Complex)
items.body:
**For Very Large Discounts:**

Example: Rp 500.000 discount (very large, > super threshold Rp 300K)

1. Cashier apply Rp 500K discount
2. First approval: Outlet manager (approval level 1)
   - Manager review
   - Approve/reject
3. If manager approve:
   - Second approval: Area supervisor (approval level 2)
   - Supervisor review (higher authority)
   - Final approve/reject
4. If supervisor approve:
   - Discount applied
5. If anyone reject:
   - Cascade reject (entire chain)
   - Cashier notified

**Configuration:**
- Admin set approval levels
- Threshold per level
- Hierarchy: Cashier → Manager → Supervisor → Director

items.title: Discount Applied BEFORE Tax
items.body:
Standard accounting practice: Discount reduce taxable amount.

**Calculation:**
```
Subtotal (before discount): Rp 100.000
Discount (item level):      -Rp 10.000
Subtotal (after discount):  Rp 90.000
PPN (11% on 90K):          +Rp 9.900
────────────────────────────────
TOTAL:                      Rp 99.900
```

**Receipt Show:**
- Subtotal: Rp 100.000
- Item discount: -Rp 10.000
- Subtotal after discount: Rp 90.000
- PPN (11%): +Rp 9.900
- TOTAL: Rp 99.900

**Why This Way?**
- Tax only on actual selling price
- Compliant dgn tax regulation
- Accurate accounting

items.title: Multiple Discounts
items.body:
If both item-level & order-level discount applied:

**Example:**
```
Items:
  - Bakso × 2 @ Rp 25K = Rp 50K (with 10% item discount = Rp 45K)
  - Es Teh × 3 @ Rp 5K = Rp 15K (no discount = Rp 15K)
  Subtotal: Rp 60K

Order-level discount: 5% on Rp 60K = Rp 3K

After all discount: Rp 60K - Rp 3K = Rp 57K
PPN 11%: +Rp 6.27K
TOTAL: Rp 63.27K
```

**Stacking Rule:**
- Item discount apply first
- Then order-level discount
- Then tax
- Total not exceed cost (prevention fraud)

items.title: Audit Trail (Compliance)
items.body:
Every discount action recorded untuk audit & compliance.

**Recorded Info:**
- Order ID
- Cashier name & ID
- Discount type (item / order / voucher)
- Discount amount & percentage
- Original total → Final total
- Reason/notes
- Manager approval status (if applicable)
- Manager name (if approved)
- Timestamp

**Example Log:**
```
2026-05-05 14:32:15 | ORD-1001 | Ahmad | Item Discount | Bakso -10% | Rp 2500 | Approved | Manager: Budi
2026-05-05 14:45:22 | ORD-1002 | Siti  | Voucher | MEMBER10 | Rp 10000 | Auto-approved
2026-05-05 15:01:45 | ORD-1003 | Ahmad | Order Discount | Rp 50000 | Manager Approval Pending
```

**Accessible To:**
- Admin (view all)
- Manager (view outlet)
- Cashier (view own)
- Finance (for reconciliation)

items.title: Daily Discount Report
items.body:
**Summary Report:**
```

Total discounts applied: Rp 1.250.000

By Type:
  Item discount:      Rp 450.000 (36%)
  Order discount:     Rp 350.000 (28%)
  Voucher discount:   Rp 450.000 (36%)

By Cashier:
  Ahmad (45 discounts): Rp 520.000
  Siti (32 discounts):  Rp 450.000
  Budi (28 discounts):  Rp 280.000

Manager Approvals:
  Requested:  8
  Approved:   7 (87.5%)
  Rejected:   1 (12.5%)

Average discount per transaction: Rp 18.700
Days with highest discount: May 4 (Rp 1.8M)
```

**Analysis:**
- Trend: Discount amount up/down?
- Per cashier: Any anomaly (too much discount)?
- Rejection rate: Manager approving appropriately?
- Revenue impact: Total lost to discount

content.body:
**Controls:**

1. **Threshold Approval:**
   - Prevent cashier unilateral large discount
   - Manager oversight
   - Reduce cash theft risk

2. **Audit Trail:**
   - Every discount recorded
   - Cannot hide or modify
   - Traceable to cashier & manager
   - Deter fraudulent discount

3. **Reason Tracking:**
   - Cashier must provide reason
   - Manager review reason
   - Identify suspicious patterns

4. **Periodic Review:**
   - Manager review cashier discount pattern
   - If high frequency or amount: Training/investigation
   - Outliers identified & escalated

5. **Discount Limits:**
   - Per-item max: 99%
   - Per-order max: 50% (configurable)
   - Per-cashier daily limit: Configurable
   - Exceed limit: Require escalation

6. **Competitor Pricing:**
   - Cannot discount below cost
   - System enforce floor price
   - Prevent loss-making sales

1. **Clear Promotion Rules:**
   - Define what discount allowed
   - Communicate to cashier & customer
   - Consistent application

2. **Regular Review:**
   - Monitor discount trend
   - Analyze ROI of promotion
   - Adjust rules based on data

3. **Training:**
   - Train cashier on discount policy
   - Emphasize fraud prevention
   - Explain approval workflow

4. **Manager Vigilance:**
   - Review approval requests promptly
   - Question suspicious reason
   - Provide feedback to cashier

5. **Customer Communication:**
   - Clear display of discount applied
   - Receipt show breakdown
   - Build customer trust

6. **Compliance:**
   - Keep audit trail
   - Retention policy (7 years min)
   - Regular audit by internal/external
   - Tax compliance (discount affect tax)
